# Lib.io.input

## Operators

- [**Gamepad**](Gamepad.md) — # Gamepad input using XInput. It supports up to four gamepads.
- [**KeyboardInput**](KeyboardInput.md) — Allows the real-time manipulation of any value using a key on the keyboard.
- [**KeyboardInputAsInt**](KeyboardInputAsInt.md) — Returns integer values from 0 to 9 for pressed numeric keys.
- [**MouseInput**](MouseInput.md) — Allows the real-time manipulation of any values using the mouse / trackpad
